title: Claude API body generation to PortableText
description: Implement the AI authoring core: given a user prompt/brief, call the Claude API (Anthropic SDK) and produce a well-formed Sanity PortableText body (blocks with the styles/marks the schema supports), plus suggested title and excerpt. Use structured output so the result maps cleanly onto the schema types from TASK-002. The API key must NOT be hardcoded; expose the model/key via runtime config and keep the call abstracted so it can run from the host's backend if the host prefers not to expose the key in the browser.
acceptance_criteria: Given a brief, the component returns a valid PortableText body that the TASK-003 renderer displays without unknown-type warnings.
Generated output includes title and excerpt suggestions mapped to the post type.
Claude model and API key are supplied via config/props, never hardcoded; prompt-caching is used where it helps.
A test exercises the generation path against a mocked Claude response and asserts the PortableText shape.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: DONE + VERIFIED + REVIEWED. generatePostBody(brief, opts) -> {title, excerpt, body: BlockContent} via forced tool emit_post + tool_choice; deterministic PortableText mapper (cross-checked by reviewer: every emitted style/mark is handled by the TASK-003 renderer or @portabletext/vue defaults, no unknownType); prompt caching (ephemeral) on system prompt; key-agnostic (host injects Anthropic client or apiKey, server-side). DEFAULT_AI_MODEL='claude-sonnet-4-6' (real id in installed SDK). Verification: build OK, 59/59 tests (16 AI, incl. 4 new malformed-output cases), lint 0 errors, typecheck clean vs @anthropic-ai/sdk@0.100.1. Reviewer (ai-gen-reviewer) PASS; MEDIUM fixed inline (validateToolOutput guards title/excerpt/blocks before cast). Deferred LOW: typecheck excludes tests/; AI offers 'code' mark but not 'highlight' (renderable but could align enum to schema) -> revisit in TASK-007.
